core/tokens/motion/slider.ts

Knob-spring tunables for the slider widgets (theme
Sourcesrc/core/tokens/motion/slider.ts
UX surfaceShared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

SNAP_K

Snap-regime stiffness — ωn² of the chase spring.

SNAP_C

Snap-regime damping — 2ζωn with ζ≈0.72 (the elastic overshoot).

DRAG_K

Drag-regime stiffness — critically damped follow (ζ=1.0 ⇒ C=2√K).

DRAG_C

Drag-regime damping — 2·√420 ≈ 41.0.

SETTLE_EPS

Settle epsilon — |target−p| and |v| both under these values snap to the stop so the knob never micro-oscillates a sub-pixel ring. Sized under half a track unit of visible travel.

VEL_EPS

Velocity settle epsilon (track units per second) — see SETTLE_EPS.

DT_MAX_S

Per-frame integration step cap (seconds) — a suspended tab resumes with a finite dt instead of a spring explosion.

DT_INIT_S

First-frame step (seconds) — the loop's initial tick assumes 60Hz.
